label: Aqit
note: Bedouin: milk churned in a goatskin, the buttermilk heated until it curdles, curd shaped into discs and dried in the shade at least a day; some accounts make it from boiled yoghurt instead (sources differ)

about.text: A dried dairy product of the Arabian Bedouin: churned buttermilk is heated until it curdles and the curd is dried into hard discs that keep for months.
